title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Chatbots for Motivational Interviewing: A Scoping Review From System Design to Intervention Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2609.20902v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motivational interviewing (MI) is a collaborative approach to elicit autonomous motivation for health behavior change. Generative AI (GenAI) offers new ways to deliver MI via conversational systems, but evidence on their design, assessment, and translation into interventions remains fragmented. This scoping review characterized evidence on GenAI-MI chatbots across system design, safety, MI quality, user perceptions, and intervention outcomes. We conducted a PRISMA-ScR scoping review. Nine datasets were searched for studies published or publicly available from January 1, 2015 to June 2, 2026 that used GenAI to generate MI chatbot responses or counselor utterances. Data were extracted using a predefined framework and synthesized descriptively. Forty-seven reports (48 studies) were included. translated_title: 用于动机性访谈的生成式人工智能聊天机器人：从系统设计到干预结果的证据范围综述
translated_abstract: 动机性访谈（MI）是一种协作式方法，旨在激发人们进行健康行为改变的自主动机。生成式人工智能（GenAI）为通过对话系统提供动机性访谈开辟了新途径，但关于其系统设计、评估以及向干预措施转化的证据仍然零散。本范围综述对GenAI-MI聊天机器人在系统设计、安全性、动机性访谈质量、用户感知和干预结果等方面的证据进行了系统刻画。我们按照PRISMA-ScR指南开展了范围综述，检索了九个数据库中2015年1月1日至2026年6月2日期间发表或公开可获取的、使用生成式AI生成动机性访谈聊天机器人回复或咨询师话语的研究。数据采用预定义框架提取并进行描述性综合。共纳入47篇报告（48项研究）。其中20项（41.7%）聚焦于系统设计而未涉及参与者的直接使用；28项（58.3%）涉及用户直接交互。大多数系统基于文本且为非具身形式……
tldr: 本范围综述系统纳入48项研究，首次全面刻画了生成式AI动机性访谈聊天机器人在系统设计、安全性、MI质量、用户感知与干预结果方面的研究现状，发现约六成研究已涉及用户直接交互，为该领域证据整合与临床转化提供了全景式参考。
en_tdlr: This scoping review of 48 studies provides the first comprehensive characterization of GenAI-based motivational interviewing chatbots across system design, safety, MI quality, user perceptions, and intervention outcomes, finding that about 58% of studies involved direct user interaction.
